name: Greater Mark Of Making
description: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Mark of Making Feat) You gain the following benefits.

Ability Score Increase.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Improved Intuition.description: When you use the Artisan’s Intuition benefit of your Mark of Making feat, you can roll 1d6 instead of 1d4.

Improved Making.description: When you use the Spellsmith benefit of your Mark of Making feat to cast Magic Weapon without a spell slot, you cast the spell as its level 3 version.
